newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Koebnick says dlr levels help Germany.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Koebnick says dlr levels help Germany.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick said the U.S. dollar's current levels were benefitting the German economy and paved the way for Germany's ongoing consolidation efforts.
"The effect of the dollar is positive for a nation that exports and imports a great deal," Koebnick told Reuters in an interview on Wednesday.
He added that the dollar's current level was more appropriate now than last year and was helping Germany's efforts to consolidate its deficit and debt in preparation for European currency union.
The dollar was trading at 1.5253 to the mark on Wednesday morning.
